name: Gordon's Sloe Gin
base_ingredient: Gordon's gin with steeped sloe berries
production: Hand-picked sloes (UK and Northern Europe) steeped gently, then Gordon's gin added
history: 1769 | Alexander Gordon starts the Gordon's distillery in London
expressions: Gordon's with a Spot of Elderflower
serve_official: Gordon's Bramble: 25 ml sloe gin, 25 ml Gordon's gin, 25 ml lemon juice, 15 ml sugar syrup, over crushed ice, blackberry + raspberry garnish; also G&T or neat
notes: Deep plum colour. Gin Guild botanical list is for the base Gordon's gin.
